ai_content.desc_en: Robbie embarks on a perilous journey to contact his deceased girlfriend through the Red Book Ritual, a dark and ancient practice that awakens supernatural forces. He gathers a group of young people to perform the ritual in an abandoned house, but the summoning unleashes unspeakable horrors. Now, Robbie and his companions must face their deepest fears to survive.
